hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Accept the complete hash-verified public-book and public-trade covariate archive for the 2440 frozen eligible treatment episodes. Freeze the operational interpretation below before opening any strategy return path. Use 5s_p95 as the sole primary intensity arm for both competing branches; retain the other three arms as diagnostic-only and prohibit them from rescuing a failed primary result. Permit development materialization first, followed by unchanged validation and pseudo-holdout evaluation. Do not change V58, select a live exit, or claim a BTC-long edge unless the revision-4 standalone, dependence, stability, concentration, shared-portfolio, and future prospective requirements are satisfied in separate immutable results.
falsifier: Reject the archive if its independent verifier no longer reconciles all 1280 tasks or any plan, manifest, raw page, normalized file, or treatment hash drifts. Reject a branch if its fixed 5s_p95 primary arm fails the revision-4 after-cost 5-minute endpoint, dependence, count, monthly-stability, doubled-slippage, concentration, or later prospective criteria. Treat any changed notional, fee, timing interval, reclaim rule, arm, horizon, overlap policy, bootstrap setting, or cost formula after outcomes are opened as a new hypothesis that cannot reuse these confirmatory partitions.

operational_experiment_contract.notional_basis: active V58 BTC maximum_notional_usd; quantity equals 5000 divided by the first executable best ask
operational_experiment_contract.fee_basis: conservative frozen BTC base taker rate; no historical tier or referral discount assumed
operational_experiment_contract.flow_interval: open-left closed-right (decision_time_ms-5000, decision_time_ms] by exchange timestamp
operational_experiment_contract.decision_book: first complete 20-level snapshot with exchange timestamp at or after decision_time_ms
operational_experiment_contract.continuation_price_condition: decision midpoint greater than or equal to exact episode VWAP
operational_experiment_contract.exhaustion_reclaim_condition: at least one post-episode pre-decision midpoint is strictly below episode VWAP and the decision midpoint is greater than or equal to episode VWAP
operational_experiment_contract.entry_fill: buy fixed quantity by walking asks on the decision book; insufficient visible depth is an explicit technical exclusion
operational_experiment_contract.exit_fill: sell the unchanged entry quantity by walking bids on the first complete snapshot at or after entry_time_ms plus the horizon; insufficient visible depth is an explicit technical exclusion
operational_experiment_contract.nominal_net_pnl: exit quote minus entry quote minus 4.5 bps of both entry and exit quote notionals plus signed official funding
operational_experiment_contract.doubled_slippage_stress: retain the observed spread once; double entry VWAP impact above best ask and double exit VWAP impact below best bid before fees and funding
operational_experiment_contract.funding: official Hyperliquid fundingHistory events in (entry_time_ms, exit_time_ms], with long cashflow equal to minus funding rate times constant entry notional
operational_experiment_contract.overlap_purge: within each exact branch-arm-partition, retain the earliest eligible entry and suppress later entries whose decision time is at or before the retained entry time plus 15 minutes
operational_experiment_contract.primary_summary: mean 5-minute net executable return in basis points over retained position-equivalent observations

bootstrap.method: stationary bootstrap of ordered UTC-day blocks with all within-day observations retained

operational_experiment_contract.competing_branch_error_control: two one-sided primary branch tests use Holm family-wise correction at alpha 0.05
operational_experiment_contract.monthly_stability: report every month; a month with at least 20 retained primary observations is materially negative when mean 5-minute net return is below zero
operational_experiment_contract.concentration: largest positive 5-minute episode PnL divided by total positive 5-minute episode PnL
operational_experiment_contract.partition_sequence: materialize development first; publish its immutable result before reading validation, then publish validation before reading pseudo-holdout
operational_experiment_contract.diagnostic_non_rescue: 30-second, 2-minute, 15-minute, non-primary arms, and regime strata are descriptive and cannot replace a failed fixed 5-minute 5s_p95 endpoint

limitations: Acquisition coverage does not establish a profitable entry, a viable live exit, or portfolio improvement.
Official funding history and causal regime labels remain to be acquired and hash-bound before an economic result is complete.
Historical exchange timestamps do not reproduce local receipt latency; the doubled-slippage stress does not substitute for a future prospective latency test.
Twenty visible levels can prove sufficient depth but cannot establish hidden liquidity, queue behavior, or actual IOC fills.
The revision-3 journal referenced a mutable live gap file that has since appended; that historical integrity defect is not an input to this hash-bound archive or experiment.
Pseudo-holdout history has been used by unrelated BTC research and is weaker than the untouched prospective period beginning 2026-08-22T03:00:00Z.
No outcome path has been inspected under this hypothesis, and no live change is supported.
This revision cannot pause, retune, route, size, enter, close, restart, or promote a live strategy or lifecycle.
